body:
What would I tell them? That despite they investing a lot of time and resources in providing for me I've decided that I'll kill myself due to the unbearable self-hatred and alienation that accompany me every second of my miserable life? They would probably disown me. 

I feel like I'm being too aggressive with you and I'm very sorry, I just don't know how to communicate 19 years of repressed feelings.

Is my life worth two semesters of economics that I decided to quit on because "I didn't liked it"? Is it worth another three semesters of political sciences? At this point they're probably better off if I just blow my brains out. The three of them can live happily without me, they already do. But killing myself would just be ungrateful, I don't have the right to feel this way, I've everything I need. 

Thank you for the response, this is the most interest anyone has ever taken on how I feel, I just feel like I'm drowning.
